thesis.en: A mountain view, a live wind map and Chiyo in the corner, talking to nobody in particular. The orange started here.
thesis.zh: 山景、即時風場圖，還有角落那個對著空氣講話的千代。橘色從這裡開始。

note.en: Back then, a homepage was a background image and three icons. It still is, honestly.
note.zh: 當年的首頁就是一張背景加三顆圖示。說實話，現在也差不多。

thesis.en: Link tiles under a pixel bonfire. Rest here, then go read the projects.
thesis.zh: 像素篝火下的一格格連結。在這裡休息一下，再去看作品。

note.en: Lasted seven years, which makes it the most stable thing I have ever shipped.
note.zh: 撐了七年，是我做過最穩定的東西。

thesis.en: The first Next.js look: a warm gradient, a big name and the JSON data layer every later look kept.
thesis.zh: 第一個 Next.js 外觀：暖色漸層、很大的名字，還有之後每個外觀都沿用的 JSON 資料層。

thesis.en: The whole site as a zsh session: typed commands, a ranger file browser and project pages opened in vim.
thesis.zh: 整個網站是一個 zsh 工作階段：打字的指令、ranger 檔案瀏覽，作品頁用 vim 打開。

note.en: Type help in the terminal. It still answers, and it still refuses sudo.
note.zh: 在終端機打 help，它還會回；打 sudo，它還是不給。

thesis.en: The portfolio as a trading terminal, with candlesticks, an order book and a buy button that buys nothing.
thesis.zh: 把作品集做成交易終端機：有 K 線、委託簿，還有一顆什麼都買不到的下單鍵。

note.en: Built two days after Terminal, as an experiment. It never went live, which in hindsight was sound risk management.
note.zh: Terminal 上線兩天後做的實驗，最後沒有上線。事後看來，這是很好的風險控管。
